name: Survivalist hunger and thirst fall only for real food and drink, not regen buffs
contract: Survivalist (challenge 213) raises thirst 1 per 10 s and hunger 1 per 16 s, shown as stacks of the Thirst 93176 and Hunger 93175 meter auras; while the player eats or drinks, the matching meter falls (drink 1 per 250 ms, food 1 per 500 ms) and stops rising. Eating and drinking mean a seated consumable: stock SpellInfo classifies a SPELLFAMILY_GENERIC spell with AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_NOT_SEATED and a regen aura as SPELL_SPECIFIC_FOOD or SPELL_SPECIFIC_DRINK, as for Drink 430 (Refreshing Spring Water 159; auras 85 and 226, interrupt flags 0x40080) and Food 433 (Tough Hunk of Bread 4540; aura 84, interrupt flags 0x40080). Grove Instinct 572810 is a Primalist family-37 buff whose only aura is SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_REGEN (85) with no interrupt flags, and Vitality 21614 is a generic buff whose only aura is SPELL_AURA_MOD_REGEN (84) with no interrupt flags; sharing those aura types with drink and food must not stop either meter rising or drain it. Grove Instinct and Vitality are fixture-applied observation carriers; their acquisition is outside this contract. After 33 s both actors must reach at least 3 thirst and 2 hunger; the regen-buffed actor keeps them while the control drinks and eats both meters back to zero.
